rows.definition: internal/metrics RenderJSON serializes a DeviceMetrics snapshot into JSON bytes, omitting unread (nil) devices so the normalized-optional contract survives to the wire; a nil snapshot renders as an empty array, not null.
rows.distinction: Serializes the device-spine snapshot to JSON - NOT RenderCSV (same snapshot, CSV format) and NOT renderMetrics (the gateway's own Prometheus exposition over different data).

rows.definition: internal/metrics RenderCSV serializes a DeviceMetrics snapshot into spreadsheet-friendly CSV with a self-describing header row; a nil snapshot renders the header alone, not an error, and values use non-scientific formatting so large byte counts stay spreadsheet-friendly.
rows.distinction: Serializes the device-spine snapshot to CSV - NOT RenderJSON (same snapshot, JSON format).

rows.definition: internal/metrics RenderProm renders a DeviceMetrics snapshot as OpenMetrics/Prometheus text via the shared descriptor table, delegating to RenderOpenMetricsText; it is a stateless reader over the same snapshot RenderJSON consumes (the one-collection-path guarantee).
rows.distinction: Renders the device-spine snapshot as Prometheus exposition - NOT RenderJSON (same snapshot, JSON) and NOT renderMetrics (the gateway's own /metrics scrape surface over different data).

rows.definition: internal/metrics RenderOpenMetricsText renders OpenMetricFamily records into deterministic OpenMetrics text exposition, sorting families by name and validating metric names and types; it is the shared text serializer RenderProm delegates to.
rows.distinction: The shared OpenMetrics text serializer - NOT RenderProm (which projects a device-spine snapshot into families THEN delegates here) and NOT renderMetrics (the gateway's own /metrics exposition).

rows.definition: internal/hostfault RenderHostFaultReport writes the operator text view of a HostFaultReport: one summary line, class counts sorted for stable output, then one line per fault event row (class, source, app, code).
rows.distinction: Renders the HOST-FAULT report (OS-level fault events) - NOT RenderConsoleFaultReport (the console-surface fault report, a different fault domain).

rows.definition: gatewayusageledger RenderCompaction renders a CompactionReport as a terse, deterministic table grouped by budget regime x session length, with shed percentile shown only for valid-denominator fired cells and a dash marking an honest absence.
rows.distinction: Renders the compaction-segmentation report TABLE - NOT RenderAudit (cache-savings reconciliation table, a different report in a different package).

rows.definition: frontierswe RenderCompareMarkdown renders a CompareReport as the raw-vs-fak Markdown table a FRONTIERSWE-RESULTS.md row is recorded from, with the parity gate and provenance stated before the ratio so the table reads in the honest order.
rows.distinction: Renders the FrontierSWE raw-vs-fak COMPARISON table - NOT RenderMarkdown (the generic bench-report renderer) and NOT RenderReportMarkdown (livecodebench's report renderer).

rows.definition: issuecontract renderEvidenceEnvelope formats the scale-evidence EnvelopeValue list as a one-line-per-dimension text block (dimension, value, unit) for an issue contract's evidence section.
rows.distinction: Formats the evidence-envelope VALUES list - NOT RenderAdoption (issuefanout's shipped-vs-filed ratio, a different package/report) and NOT RenderOutcomes (issuefanout's terminal-outcome fold).

rows.definition: systemservice RenderLaunchDaemon renders a PID-1-owned system-domain launchd plist from a LaunchdConfig, loaded by PID 1 from /Library/LaunchDaemons so it survives Terminal, WindowServer, and GUI-login teardown; XML-escapes every operator-supplied path so ProgramArguments stays a well-formed array.
rows.distinction: Renders the SYSTEM-DAEMON plist (PID-1-owned, /Library/LaunchDaemons, KeepAlive) - NOT RenderLaunchAgent (the source-compatible alias that delegates here, not a separate renderer) and NOT RenderSystemdSystemUnit (the Linux systemd sibling, a different OS service manager).

rows.definition: systemservice RenderLaunchAgent is a source-compatible alias that delegates to RenderLaunchDaemon; it deliberately renders the system-domain contract, and new callers should use RenderLaunchDaemon directly.
rows.distinction: An ALIAS that forwards to RenderLaunchDaemon - NOT RenderLaunchDaemon (the primary PID-1-owned system-daemon renderer it delegates to) and NOT RenderSystemdUserUnit (the Linux systemd alias sibling in the same package).

rows.definition: issuefanout RenderLive prints the fanout --live result for a human: the filed/skipped/failed fold, one line per candidate row, and a rerun-clean notice when every candidate was already filed.
rows.distinction: Renders the issue-fanout LIVE result (filed/skipped/failed) - NOT RenderOutcomes (the terminal-outcome fold in the same package).

rows.definition: repoguard renderNetworkLoopReason formats the advisory refusal block for FOREGROUND_NETWORK_LOOP findings: the reason, each violating op->target with its fix, and the silence-env guidance.
rows.distinction: Formats the NETWORK-LOOP-specific refusal - NOT renderReason (repoguard's generic violation-reason renderer) and NOT renderWorkspaceCdReason (the workspace-cd refusal text).

rows.definition: cmd/fak renderPrePushBuild writes the trunk-build-gate verdict line (OK, NOOP, GATE_LATENCY_REGRESSION, SKIPPED_CONTENDED, COULD_NOT_RUN, TRUNK_ALREADY_RED, TRUNK_WOULD_NOT_COMPILE) to the push output.
rows.distinction: Renders the pre-push BUILD-GATE verdict - NOT renderReleaseShip (the release-ship OK/REFUSED result line, a different release-flow verdict).

rows.definition: cmd/fak renderSyncPushVelocity writes the one human projection of PushResult.Velocity: elapsed/budget ratio, score/grade when qualified, or the UNSCORED reason when the push did not publish.
rows.distinction: Renders the PUSH velocity (push elapsed/budget) - NOT renderSyncApplyVelocity (the apply velocity, a different operation in the same file).

rows.definition: cmd/fak renderSyncApplyVelocity writes the apply-velocity result: score/grade/elapsed/budget when qualified, or the UNSCORED reason (no fast-forward effect) when not.
rows.distinction: Renders the APPLY velocity (fast-forward apply score) - NOT renderSyncPushVelocity (the push velocity, a different operation in the same file).

rows.definition: systemservice RenderSystemdSystemUnit renders a PID-1-owned systemd system unit from a SystemdConfig, using DynamicUser=yes so systemd allocates a transient unprivileged identity while PID 1 retains lifecycle and durable-directory ownership; no login account or user manager is in the dependency chain, and hardening directives (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem, ProtectKernelModules) lock the unit down.
rows.distinction: Renders the SYSTEM unit (PID-1-owned, DynamicUser, multi-user.target) - NOT RenderSystemdUserUnit (the source-compatible alias that delegates here, not a separate renderer) and NOT RenderLaunchDaemon (the macOS launchd sibling, a different OS service manager).

rows.definition: systemservice RenderSystemdUserUnit is a source-compatible alias that delegates to RenderSystemdSystemUnit; it deliberately renders the system-owned contract, and new callers should use the explicit RenderSystemdSystemUnit name.
rows.distinction: An ALIAS that forwards to RenderSystemdSystemUnit - NOT RenderSystemdSystemUnit (the primary PID-1-owned system-unit renderer it delegates to) and NOT RenderLaunchAgent (the macOS launchd alias sibling in the same package).

rows.definition: sessionaudit RenderTaskBudget renders a TaskBudget readout as one inline line: spend (with target fraction and OVER flag), turns, tool-call count, and the coarse reads/edits/other breakdown.
rows.distinction: Renders the session-audit TASK-BUDGET inline line - NOT renderModelMix (sessionaudit's per-tier cost/output-share table, a different report in the same package).

rows.definition: fleettrend RenderThroughput renders the one fleet-status throughput row: lands/resumes/deaths rates, goodput percentage, and the window label, with a provenance tag so self-reported goodput never reads as witnessed.
rows.distinction: Renders the fleet-trend THROUGHPUT row - NOT renderFleet (loophealth's per-loop-ledger fleet fold, a different fleet-status table).

rows.definition: agentsindex Doc.RenderTOC returns the resident table-of-contents block body: a one-line orientation, then one title-only row per level>=2 section with its slug and estimated token price, bounded by TOCBudgetTokens.
rows.distinction: Renders the agentsindex RESIDENT TOC block (a budgeted AGENTS.md map for CLAUDE.md) - NOT renderInfoGlossaryBody (the info-pane glossary overlay body, a different in-console text surface).

rows.definition: milestonereport renderVelocity renders the code-movement lens beside the epic roadmap: a header counting movers vs total modules, then the top lane rev movers; an unmeasured ledger renders one honest line rather than a fabricated zero.
rows.distinction: Renders the milestone-report MODULE VELOCITY lens (code movement) - NOT renderSyncPushVelocity (the sync push-velocity, a completely different velocity concept).

rows.definition: cmd/fak releaseStatusRenderContents renders the release-contents digest as one compact human line: commit/lane counts, top 3 lanes by commit, and up to 4 resolved-issue numbers.
rows.distinction: Renders the release-status CONTENTS digest line - NOT renderReleaseShip (the release-ship OK/REFUSED verdict line) and NOT renderPRPlanMarkdown (the promotion PR-plan markdown).
